title: Estate Accounting Note: Payable of a Later Distribution-Margin Allocation Retired for an Estate — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital)
content:
# Payable of a Later Distribution-Margin Allocation Retired for an Estate

*Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) — accounting note.*

## Valuation clause

The payable of a later distribution-margin allocation retired for an estate is its gross, the allocated amount of that year still unretired, discounted at the class's estate discount rate a year, compounded once a year, over the whole number of years from the calendar year of the retirement to its allocation year plus the class's expected rotation years, never fewer than zero years; the payable is rounded half up to the cent.

## The gross and the estate annual cap

The gross of the row is the lesser of two amounts, rounded to the cent:

1. the allocated amount of that distribution-margin year as booked, less every general retirement already booked on it; and
2. the room left under the class's estate annual cap — the cap less the gross estate retirement already booked in the calendar year of the retirement, and never below zero.

## Terms

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Row | one distribution-margin allocation year booked to the deceased member's account after the estate's board approval |
| Year of the retirement | the calendar year in which the row is booked for the estate |
| Rotation year | the allocation year plus the class's expected rotation years |
| Years of discount | the whole years from the year of the retirement to the rotation year; zero where the rotation year is not later |
| Rate | the class's estate discount rate, a percent a year |

One plus the rate, as a decimal, is raised to the power of the years of discount; the gross divided by the result, rounded half up to the cent, is the payable. Rounding happens once, on the payable of the row, and never on an intermediate figure.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

A rate of 5 percent, an expected rotation of 20 years and a cap of $20,000.00 are assumed for this illustration only. A 2024 distribution-margin allocation of $860.00, nothing yet retired, is booked for the estate in 2026.

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Unretired amount of the row | $860.00 |
| Cap room (no estate retirement yet this year) | $20,000.00 |
| Gross (the lesser) | $860.00 |
| Rotation year, 2024 plus 20 | 2044 |
| Years of discount, 2026 to 2044 | 18 |
| 1.05 raised to the power 18 | 2.406619 |
| Payable, $860.00 divided by 2.406619 | **$357.35** |

Had $19,700.00 of gross estate retirement already been booked in 2026, the cap room would be $300.00, the gross $300.00, and the payable $300.00 divided by 2.406619, that is **$124.66**.
